pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition of adding to positions during high-volatility expansions; scaling is only permitted after a position has achieved a minimum 1.5R floating profit and volatility index normalizes.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Zero order execution permitted within 15 minutes before or after high-impact macroeconomic data releases, backed by an ATR-based liquidity filter confirming spread compression.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate aggressive trailing profit locks and scale-outs (50% volume) the exact moment a trade hits +$15.00 to prevent profit evaporation.
